name: Access Request Decision
description: Sent to a user to notify them whether their request for an app was approved or denied.
subject: Your access request for ${requestedObjectName} has been #if($approved)approved#{else}denied#end
body:
#if ($approved)

Your access request has been approved

#else

Your access request has been denied

#end

Hello ${user.name},

#if(${roleRequestEnabled})

Your request for the #if(${requestedObjectType}=="Role") role #elseif(${requestedObjectType}=="Entitlement") entitlement #else access profile #end ${requestedObjectName}#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) for ${requestedForIdentityName}#end.

#else

Your request for ${accessProfileName}#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) for ${requestedForIdentityName}#end.

#end#if(${requestedObjectType}=="Role" && ${accessRequestMetadata} && ${accessRequestMetadata.get("requestContextInformation")})

Requested dimension attributes:

    #foreach($key in ${accessRequestMetadata.get("requestContextInformation").keySet()})
  • ${key}: ${accessRequestMetadata.get("requestContextInformation").get($key)}
    • #end
#end#if ($approved)

#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName)The request has been approved. The system is currently processing the creation of the user's access.#else Your request has been approved. The system is currently processing the creation of your access.#end

#if(${roleRequestEnabled})#if($accessibleItems && $accessibleItems.size() > 0)

This means that #if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) the user now has #else you now have #end access to the following: #set($sep="")#foreach($item in $accessibleItems) $sep$item #set($sep=", ")#end.

#end#end#if ($activationRequired && $requesterName == $requestedForIdentityName)

This access requires activation before each use. To activate it, go to MySailPoint > Launchpad > Just-In-Time Access.

#end#if ($startDate)

#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) The user's access #else Your access #end to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to start on ${startDate}.

#end#if ($removeDate)

#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) The user's access #else Your access #end to ${requestedObjectName} is scheduled to end on ${removeDate}.

#end#else

Your request has been denied.

#if ($reviewerComment)

${rejecterName} included the following comment:
"$reviewerComment"

#end

Please contact ${rejecterName} if you have any questions.

#end

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
